name: Mesh Shader: Transient Isosurface Extraction
aliases: Task and Mesh Shader Isosurface Extraction
Transient Isosurface Extraction and Rendering of PVS
definition: Each mesh shader workgroup (32 threads) extracts geometry for up to 32 sparsely distributed cells and passes it directly to the rasterizer.
summary: Transient isosurface extraction is a rasterization-based method that extracts isosurface geometry on the fly using task and mesh shader pipelines, passing primitives directly to the rasterizer without intermediate explicit mesh storage.
